skills.name: SI Base Units and Homogeneity
skills.description: Classify physical quantities and SI units as base or derived, derive unit forms, use metric prefixes, and check equations for dimensional homogeneity.

skills.name: Errors and Uncertainties
skills.description: Distinguish precision from accuracy, classify systematic and random errors, and combine fractional, percentage, or absolute measurement uncertainties.

skills.name: Scalars and Vectors
skills.description: Identify defining and shared properties of scalar and vector quantities, classify examples, resolve vectors into perpendicular components, and apply geometrical trigonometry to physical systems.

skills.name: Scalar and Vector Properties
skills.description: Define scalar and vector quantities, identify their shared and distinguishing properties, and classify physical quantities as scalar or vector.

skills.name: Vector Components and Resultants
skills.description: Construct resultant-vector diagrams and calculate resultant magnitudes and directions by resolving vectors into perpendicular components.

skills.name: Measurement Error Characterisation
skills.description: Distinguish precision from accuracy and identify or explain systematic and random errors in measurements.

skills.name: Uncertainty Propagation
skills.description: Propagate fractional or percentage uncertainties through calculated quantities and convert between percentage and absolute uncertainty.

skills.name: Physical Quantities and Estimates
skills.description: Estimate plausible orders of magnitude for everyday physical quantities.

skills.name: Measurement Instruments and Scales
skills.description: Select and use suitable measuring instruments, scales, and experimental methods.

skills.name: Equations of Motion
skills.description: Apply constant-acceleration kinematics equations to linear and vertical motion, and identify property conditions of validity.

skills.name: Motion Graphs
skills.description: Interpret and determine displacement, velocity, and acceleration from displacement-time and velocity-time graphs.

skills.name: Projectile Motion
skills.description: Analyse two-dimensional projectile motion and identify trajectory property relationships by resolving independent horizontal and vertical components.

skills.name: Displacement, Velocity and Acceleration
skills.description: State and apply definitions of distance, displacement, speed, velocity, and acceleration.

skills.name: Newton's Laws of Motion
skills.description: Apply Newton's laws of motion, solve resultant force problems (F_net = ma), and distinguish fundamental properties of force and inertia.

skills.name: Momentum and Collisions
skills.description: Calculate momentum (p = mv), relate momentum to kinetic energy, apply conservation of linear momentum, and classify collisions as elastic or inelastic.

skills.name: Impulse and Force–Time Graphs
skills.description: Calculate impulse and change in momentum from force and time (Delta p = F Delta t).

skills.name: Resistive Forces and Terminal Velocity
skills.description: Analyse non-uniform motion, fluid resistance, drag forces, and terminal velocity.

skills.name: Relative Speed in Elastic Collisions
skills.description: Apply relative speed of approach equals relative speed of separation for perfectly elastic collisions.

skills.name: Moments and Couples
skills.description: Apply equilibrium conditions, the principle of moments, and the torque of a couple to solve problems and deduce rotational property relationships.

skills.name: Equilibrium of Forces
skills.description: Define conditions and identify equilibrium property relationships for coplanar forces, and solve using closed vector polygons and resolution.

skills.name: Density and Pressure
skills.description: Define and calculate density (rho = m / V), solid contact pressure (p = F / A), and hydrostatic fluid pressure (Delta p = rho g Delta h).

skills.name: Upthrust and Flotation
skills.description: Apply Archimedes' principle to calculate upthrust and analyse floating or submerged bodies.

skills.name: Work Done and Energy Transfer
skills.description: Calculate work done by a force (W = F s cos theta) and gas expansion (W = p Delta V).

skills.name: Kinetic and Potential Energy
skills.description: Calculate, relate, and identify property characteristics of gravitational potential energy (Delta E_p = mg Delta h) and kinetic energy (E_k = 1/2 mv^2).

skills.name: Conservation of Energy
skills.description: Apply the principle of conservation of energy to mechanical and non-conservative systems.

skills.name: Power and Efficiency
skills.description: Calculate mechanical and electrical power (P = Fv, P = W/t) and energy conversion efficiency.

skills.name: Hooke's Law and Elastic Energy
skills.description: State, classify, and apply Hooke's law (F = kx), determine elastic properties, and calculate elastic strain energy from force-extension graphs.

skills.name: Young Modulus
skills.description: Calculate tensile stress, tensile strain, and the Young modulus (E = sigma / epsilon) for solid materials.

skills.name: Elastic and Plastic Behaviour
skills.description: Distinguish elastic and plastic deformation, limit of proportionality, and interpret stress-strain curves.

skills.name: Progressive Wave Properties
skills.description: Apply the wave equation (v = f lambda), determine frequency, period, wavelength, phase difference, and identify progressive wave property characteristics.

skills.name: Wave Intensity and Amplitude
skills.description: Relate wave intensity to amplitude squared and distance from source (I proportional to A^2).

skills.name: Doppler Effect
skills.description: Explain and calculate observed frequency shifts for moving sound sources (f_o = f_s v / (v +- v_s)), define Doppler effect, and identify motion-frequency properties.

skills.name: Electromagnetic Spectrum
skills.description: Classify and identify regions, characteristic wavelengths, frequencies, and properties across the EM spectrum.

skills.name: Polarisation and Malus's Law
skills.description: Explain wave polarisation and calculate transmitted intensities using Malus's law (I = I_0 cos^2 theta).

skills.name: Cathode-Ray Oscilloscope Traces
skills.description: Determine wave amplitude, period, and frequency from cathode-ray oscilloscope (CRO) displays.

skills.name: Stationary Waves
skills.description: Explain stationary wave formation, identify nodes and antinodes, determine resonant harmonics, and identify stationary wave property characteristics.

skills.name: Diffraction
skills.description: Describe and explain diffraction of sound, light, and microwaves through gaps and around obstacles.

skills.name: Two-Source Interference
skills.description: Apply coherence, path difference, and the double-slit equation (x = lambda D / a), and identify fringe property relationships.

skills.name: Diffraction Grating
skills.description: Calculate diffraction angles, grating spacing, and maximum orders using d sin theta = n lambda.

skills.name: Current and Drift Velocity
skills.description: Relate electric current to charge flow and quantised charge carriers (Q = It, Q = Ne) and drift velocity (I = nAvq).

skills.name: Potential Difference and Power
skills.description: Calculate electrical potential difference, energy transfer, and power dissipation (P = VI = I^2 R).

skills.name: I–V Characteristics and Resistance
skills.description: Apply Ohm's law (V = IR) and interpret I–V characteristics for ohmic conductors, filament lamps, thermistors, and semiconductor diodes to identify conduction property relationships.

skills.name: Resistivity
skills.description: Calculate resistance and resistivity of uniform conductors (R = rho L / A) and deduce conductor property relationships.

skills.name: Uniform Electric Fields
skills.description: Determine electric field strength (E = Delta V / d), electric force on charged particles (F = qE), and classify uniform electric field properties and particle paths.

skills.name: E.M.F. and Internal Resistance
skills.description: Relate source e.m.f., internal resistance, terminal potential difference (E = V + Ir), source power, output power, and source efficiency.

skills.name: Kirchhoff's Laws
skills.description: Apply Kirchhoff's first and second laws to multi-loop and series-parallel electrical circuits, and identify circuit property relationships and conservation laws.

skills.name: Resistor Networks
skills.description: Calculate total equivalent resistance for series, parallel, and bridge resistor networks, and identify network property relationships.

skills.name: Potential Dividers
skills.description: Analyse output voltages in fixed, LDR, and thermistor potential divider circuits, and identify divider property relationships and sensor behaviour.

skills.name: Potentiometer Circuits
skills.description: Calculate balance lengths and compare unknown e.m.f.s using uniform potentiometer wires.

skills.name: Nuclear Structure and Alpha Scattering
skills.description: Describe alpha particle scattering evidence, atomic property structure, and the nuclear model of the atom.

skills.name: Nuclear Radiation and Decay
skills.description: Balance radioactive decay equations, distinguish radiation types and properties, and apply conservation of charge, nucleon number, proton number, mass-energy, and momentum in nuclear decay.

skills.name: Quarks and Hadrons
skills.description: Determine quark compositions, charges, and baryon numbers of protons, neutrons, baryons, and mesons, and classify hadrons.

skills.name: Fundamental Particles and Beta Decay
skills.description: Classify leptons and hadrons, identify decay products, compare particle properties, and explain beta-minus and beta-plus decay at the quark level.

skills.name: Gravitational Fields and Potential
skills.description: Define and apply gravitational potential and field strength for point masses and spherical bodies.

skills.name: Gravitational Energy and Orbital Dynamics
skills.description: Apply energy conservation involving gravitational potential energy and kinetic energy for celestial bodies and orbits.

skills.name: Coulomb's Law and Electric Force
skills.description: State Coulomb's law and calculate electrostatic forces between point charges.

skills.name: Circular Motion Dynamics and Centripetal Force
skills.description: Analyse circular motion by relating centripetal acceleration and force to orbital period and speed.

skills.name: Pair Annihilation and PET Scanning
skills.description: Explain electron-positron pair annihilation and its application in medical PET scanning.

skills.name: Specific Heat Capacity and Specific Latent Heat
skills.description: Define and calculate thermal energy transfers involving specific heat capacity and latent heat of fusion or vaporisation.

skills.name: Ideal Gas Equation and Molar Calculations
skills.description: Apply the ideal gas equation pV = nRT and pV = NkT to determine gas state parameters.

skills.name: First Law of Thermodynamics and Work Done
skills.description: Apply the first law of thermodynamics delta U = q + w and calculate work done p delta V during gas expansion and phase change.

skills.name: Damped Oscillations and Resonance
skills.description: Define resonance and explain forced oscillations and damping effects in coupled oscillating systems.

skills.name: SHM Equations and Graphical Analysis
skills.description: Analyse simple harmonic oscillations using sinusoidal equations, determine period, phase difference, and scale graphical axes.

skills.name: SHM Energy Interchange and Graphs
skills.description: Calculate total, kinetic and potential energies in simple harmonic motion and sketch energy-displacement graphs.

skills.name: Capacitance Definition and Combinations
skills.description: Define capacitance and derive or calculate equivalent capacitance for series and parallel capacitor combinations.

skills.name: Capacitor Energy and Exponential Discharge
skills.description: Calculate energy stored in capacitors and analyse exponential discharge through resistors using time constants.

skills.name: Force on Current-Carrying Conductors
skills.description: State conditions for magnetic force on conductors, calculate F = BIL sin theta, and explain interaction between parallel current-carrying wires.

skills.name: Magnetic Field Patterns and Solenoids
skills.description: Sketch and analyse magnetic field patterns, field directions, and relative flux density for solenoids and straight wires.

skills.name: Faraday's and Lenz's Laws of Electromagnetic Induction
skills.description: State Faraday's and Lenz's laws, sketch induced e.m.f. waveforms from changing flux graphs, and explain electromagnetic repulsion effects.

skills.name: Wave-Particle Duality and de Broglie Wavelength
skills.description: Recall experimental evidence for duality (photoelectric effect, electron diffraction), calculate de Broglie wavelength, and explain macroscopic diffraction limits.

skills.name: Hubble's Law, Redshift, and the Big Bang Theory
skills.description: State Hubble's law, explain how cosmological redshift evidence implies an expanding universe, and explain how this leads to the Big Bang model.

skills.name: Radioactive Decay Law and Graphical Relationships
skills.description: Define radioactive decay, sketch and interpret exponential decay and activity-number graphs, identify decay gradients, and calculate remaining fractions.

skills.name: Motion of Charged Particles in Magnetic Fields
skills.description: Analyse the circular trajectory and forces acting on charged particles moving through uniform magnetic and electric fields.

skills.name: SHM Principles, Force and Angular Frequency
skills.description: Define simple harmonic motion, apply F = -kx to derive angular frequency omega, and analyse restoring forces.

skills.name: Damped Oscillations and Energy Loss
skills.description: Analyse energy dissipation and calculate energy decrease in damped simple harmonic oscillations.

skills.name: Damping Regimes and Displacement–Time Graphs
skills.description: Interpret and sketch displacement–time behaviour for underdamped, critically damped, and overdamped oscillating systems.

skills.name: Electric Potential and Field Strength Superposition
skills.description: Define electric field lines and potential, calculate scalar potential superposition from multiple point charges, and deduce resultant field directions.

skills.name: Alternating Current Rectification and Smoothing
skills.description: Analyse full-wave bridge rectifier circuits, output voltage waveforms, polarities, and capacitive smoothing calculations.

skills.name: Photoelectric Effect and Photon Model
skills.description: Analyse photoelectric emission, Einstein's photoelectric equation, work function, threshold frequency, and graphical representations.

skills.name: Nuclear Binding Energy, Fusion, and Fission
skills.description: Analyse nuclear binding energy per nucleon curves, mass defect, energy released in fusion/fission reactions, and molar quantities.

skills.name: X-ray Production, Attenuation, and CT Scanning
skills.description: Explain X-ray generation, CT slice combination, calculate linear attenuation  = I_0 \exp(-\mu x)$, and evaluate image contrast.

skills.name: AC Waveforms, Sinusoidal Equations and Mean Power
skills.description: Determine peak and rms voltages, write sinusoidal AC equations V = V_0 sin(omega t), and calculate mean power dissipation.

skills.name: Wien's Displacement Law, Black-Body Radiation, and Redshift
skills.description: Apply Wien's displacement law lambda_MAX proportional to 1/T, analyse stellar black-body spectra, and explain redshift and spectroscopic measurement.

skills.name: Stellar Luminosity, Radiant Flux, and Stefan-Boltzmann Law
skills.description: Define luminosity and radiant flux intensity, apply inverse square law F = L / (4 pi d^2), Stefan-Boltzmann law L = 4 pi sigma r^2 T^4, and mass-energy conversion.

skills.name: Temperature Scales and Thermometers
skills.description: Understand physical properties varying with temperature, calibrate thermometers, and relate empirical scales to the thermodynamic temperature scale.

skills.name: Kinetic Theory of Gases and Molecular Speeds
skills.description: Understand kinetic theory assumptions, use pressure relation pV = (1/3)Nm<c^2>, relate molecular kinetic energy to thermodynamic temperature, and calculate r.m.s. speed.

skills.name: Hall Effect and Hall Voltage
skills.description: Explain the origin of the Hall voltage, relate Hall voltage to magnetic flux density, thickness, and charge carrier density using V_H = BI / (ntq).

skills.name: Piezoelectric Transducers and Ultrasound Production
skills.description: Explain the generation and detection of ultrasound waves using piezoelectric transducers and the propagation of ultrasound through media.

skills.name: Atomic Energy Levels and Line Spectra
skills.description: Analyze discrete electron energy levels in atoms and transitions producing emission and absorption line spectra.

skills.name: Digital Signals, Sampling and Analogue-to-Digital Conversion
skills.description: Understand digital signals as discrete levels, sampling frequency, ADC resolution, and binary voltage representation.

skills.name: Operational Amplifiers, Negative Feedback and Amplifier Circuits
skills.description: Analyse ideal operational amplifiers, effects of negative feedback on amplifier gain and bandwidth, inverting and non-inverting circuits, and output saturation.

skills.name: Band Theory and Conduction in Solids
skills.description: Explain discrete energy levels spreading into valence and conduction bands in solids and conduction in semiconductors and LDRs.
